根据容器当前信息转换，无法还原原始 docker run 命令、参数来源或创建后: Converted from current container information. The original docker run command, argument sources and settings changed after creation cannot be recovered.

展示当前项目文件中的 service 配置，可能与容器创建时不同；其他 serv: Shows the service configuration in the current project files, which may differ from when the container was created. Other services are included only as dependency references.
环境变量按当前项目环境解析，不代表容器创建时的值。: Environment variables are resolved using the current project environment and may differ from their values when the container was created.
当前 Compose 版本会解析 env_file，返回界面前已隐藏环境变量值；: This Compose version resolves env_file. Environment values are hidden before display; variable expressions remain references.
环境变量值已隐藏；变量表达式及 env_file 引用保留，尚未解析环境文件。: Environment values are hidden. Variable expressions and env_file references are preserved; environment files have not been resolved.
操作已取消；已导入的镜像不会回滚，请刷新核对。: Cancelled. Imported images are not rolled back; refresh to verify.
镜像任务提前结束，未确认成功，请核对实际状态。: The image task ended before success was confirmed. Verify its actual state.
文件传输未完成校验，请核对目标文件。: File verification is incomplete. Check the destination file.
文件传输未完成，请核对实际状态。: The file transfer did not complete. Verify its actual state.
\n远程暂存位置：{0}。断线或异常关闭后可能需要手动清理；请先核对任务状态。: Remote staging directory: {0}. Manual cleanup may be needed after a disconnect or unexpected close; check the task state first.
归档字节已传完，正在回读校验并安全保存；大文件可能需要较长时间。: All archive bytes have been transferred. Read-back verification and safe commit are in progress; large files may take some time.
归档已通过校验，正在加载到 Docker；此阶段没有文件传输速度。: The archive has been verified and is being loaded into Docker. No file transfer speed applies at this stage.
一次请选择一个镜像归档文件。: Select one image archive at a time.
生成 tar 归档并下载到本机，保留所选标签；无标签镜像按 ID 导出。不会覆盖: Create a tar archive and download it locally, retaining the selected tag. Untagged images are exported by ID. Existing files will not be overwritten.
选择其它环境通过 docker save 生成的归档，上传后执行 load。归档: Choose an archive created with docker save in another environment. It will be uploaded and loaded. Matching image tags may be replaced; existing containers are not updated automatically.
请选择有效文件；导出文件名须以 .tar 结尾，不能包含路径分隔符。: Choose a valid file. Export names must end in .tar and contain no path separators.
镜像导入完成，请核对镜像列表。: Image loaded. Check the image list to verify.
取消不会回滚已导入的镜像；异常后请刷新核对，不要直接重复执行。: Cancellation does not roll back imported images. After an error, refresh and verify before retrying.
